subject: ioslides_presentation with runtime: shiny not rendering properly in browser

messages.author: 3111a18eedad827b
messages.subject: ioslides_presentation with runtime: shiny not rendering properly in browser
parts:
Hi All,

I am having trouble getting even the default RStudio rmarkdown ioslides+shiny example to render properly in the browser (i.e. by including runtime: shiny in the header). In renders correctly in the RStudio viewer but not in any of my tested browsers. In the browser, the content from all slides runs together, it looks almost like an html_output document. I get the same result whether I use rmarkdown::run or by clicking "Open in Browser" from the RStudio viewer.

A static ioslides_presentation works in both RStudio and in the browser. The trouble seems to be isolated to the shiny runtime.

I have attached the Rmd file I'm using (which is just the one that RStudio produces upon creating a new file), and an image showing how it appears in Chrome and RStudio.

I'm using:
  • rmarkdown 0.5.1
  • Chrome 40.0.2214.94 m
  • R 3.1.2
  • Shiny 0.11
  • RStudio 0.98.1091
Any help would be wonderful - which could simply be someone pointing out that this is working as intended.

Thanks,
Jeff

Hi,

We found what appears to be the underlying issue on Windows--would you be willing to update your rmarkdown package to see if it resolves your problem?

devtools::install_github("rstudio/rmarkdown")

Restart your session after installing, then try running your Shiny presentation again; all should be well in both the preview pane and browser.

Jonathan.
